notes: Re-traced Oct 28 from a sharp 1080p near-frontal frame (Demo 43's trace came from a 960 px contact-sheet tile and the script's strokes merged into one blob, unreadable in the game). The oval is an ellipse fitted to the panel's edge in that frame (axes 2.04:1, long axis rising 14 deg to the right), drawn as a clean ellipse; the panel is a light warm-grey printed face (faint dashed route lines, deckled edge, not modelled) on a black 15 cm return, hung below the purple fascia with the lime paint-splash mural. 'Journeys' is the hand-lettered faux-neon script: pale cyan tubes with white cores, traced at 2x with light smoothing so every stroke stays separate (the J's descender, the o with the green globe inside it, the u-r-n ligature, the e, the y's tail crossing under the s). Compass marks as their own flat parts: orange chevrons left of the J and between the N and E, yellow arrows above and below the J, the green globe in the o. Scale: long axis taken as 2.4 m (from the 3 m door opening; not measured), so the panel's box is 2.33 x 1.21 m and the lettering 1.48 m across. Interior behind (for the walk-in, IMG_4440 f012-f019): olive-green slatwall bays of sneakers and boots both sides with poster panels, a red-brick accent wall at the back left, a corrugated-steel soffit with lit coves over the aisle, black open ceiling, grey slate-look tile floor, two honey-oak Timberland display tables on casters at the entry, galvanised Tolix-style chairs, a Birkenstock mat and a hi-5 candy neighbour to the west. Oct 28, after the first baked shot: the pale tubes on the pale panel read faint from the hall, so the letters got a dark slate outline behind them (the 'edge' part: the same mask 3 % larger, 1 cm behind the faces, the dark edge the real tubes show), darker returns and a brighter face.
